backlogged.summary: The '## Language' section is duplicated near-verbatim across 11 files (AGENTS.md, 7 skills, 3 agents). This is required by AC-1's per-file test, but it means any future wording tweak has to be repeated 11 times by hand with no shared source.

test/f60-field-accuracy.test.mjs's timeout values (8000ms/1s -> 12000ms/5s) were changed in this diff for load stability, unrelated to F61's language feature; a reasonable bundled fix but outside this contract's scope.

init.mjs's --language validation uses HarnessError code 'usage' for a missing value versus 'config_invalid' for a malformed one; consistent with existing CLI conventions but worth confirming both map to exit 2 as tested.
